create.title: Uniform actual sampled-k row bound and prescribed polylogarithmic q-shell
create.statement_tex: On every residual hard top M2 row b=a+2q with a asymp b asymp A and q asymp D, retain the exact actual coefficient F_a(q), including primitive and prior-owner masks, the moving open reciprocal interval, finite odd lifts, actual profiles, floors, stars, fixed physical collars, the full punctured metric density and every discrepancy mode, both orientations, saddle entry and exit, and zero extension. Then |F_a(q)| <<_epsilon X^epsilon L^2/A uniformly for real X, including collapsing, empty, and singleton reciprocal fibres, and sum_(a asymp A,q asymp D)|F_a(q)|^2 <<_epsilon X^epsilon D L^4/A. Consequently the canonical fixed-a Gram target holds on every prescribed range D <= (log(2+X))^C for fixed C. The proof uses complete actual sampled-k variation, odd nonzero metric frequency, and reciprocal second-derivative cancellation. It does not prove any fixed positive-power q-shell.
create.next_action: Use this row theorem once. For polynomial D, prove the complete signed cross-q correlation before rowwise absolute values; do not repeat fixed-q sampled-k or q=1 analysis.
create.reason_for_promotion: The literal complete centered integral has uniform sampled-k variation sqrt(AL/(JD)) through both physical collars and the collapsing cone edge. Every metric mode has odd nonzero frequency and reciprocal curvature nA^2/(JD); the two exact Fourier half-moments yield O(L+1) per lift and O(L^2/A) per row. Owner and source audits leave no jagged k-mask or external dependency. Row energy plus Cauchy closes every prescribed polylogarithmic shell.

update.next_action: The complete actual fixed-q row is proved and the rowwise Cauchy route has exact D^2 deficit. Prove a polynomial-shell signed q-shift correlation for the full mode-resolved actual coefficient, retaining both moving reciprocal fibres, both lift sets, all owners, density and discrepancy modes, and entry/exit.
Use the proved fixed-q actual row and polylogarithmic shell once. The remaining core is the polynomial-shell complete signed q-correlation; rowwise Cauchy loses exactly D^2.
The fixed and prescribed polylogarithmic primitive-ray shells are discharged. Prove the remaining polynomial-shell canonical density-discrepancy energy before invoking the hard-cone assembly.

reject.reason: Carrier cancellation is an exact change of representation. The literal complete centered coefficient has independently proved sampled-k variation, which dephases the physical Fourier coefficient before the remaining complete metric reciprocal modes are estimated.
The proof uses the exact homogeneous actual profile, resolved physical collars, and literal owner placement. Arbitrary phase-conjugated k-coefficients can violate the bound.
The row energy is D L^4/A and the Cauchy Gram bound is H^2 D L^4/A, whereas the target is H^2 L^4/(A D); the exact route deficit is D^2.
The coherent coefficient shadow saturating Cauchy is not the literal actual symbol. No lower bound for the signed actual Gram is proved, so polynomial-shell cross-q cancellation remains possible.

The reciprocal interval and physical saddle path collapse together, the proof never divides by their length, overlapping collars retain uniform seminorms, and empty or singleton fibres are handled directly.

no_change.reason: Only the fixed-q row and prescribed polylogarithmic shell are closed; every fixed positive-power signed q-correlation remains open.
The canonical polynomial-shell Gram still requires an actual signed cross-q theorem.
The remaining polynomial-shell hard cone is open.
The canonical hard polynomial shell and two smooth M2 packets remain open.
Round 104 is confined to a disjoint M2 primitive-ray input.
No all-denominator pointwise endpoint assembly is proved.
Neither M9-M1 nor M9-M2 is closed.
